# UNH — Catalysts

## TL;DR

All near-term catalysts have fired or been absorbed. Q1 2026 earnings (April 21) beat by 10.2% and are priced into the +34.6% recent move. Goldman Sachs added UNH to its US Conviction Buy list at $435 PT on May 1, lifting the analyst average to $388.57 — but at $370.12 the stock is only 5% below that average, meaning the upgrade cycle is nearly exhausted as a price driver. Next scheduled binary: Q2 2026 earnings (~July 10–28). Notable structural development: UnitedHealthcare eliminated most prior authorizations for medical procedures — a long-term member-retention positive. Live risks: RICO insulin-pricing lawsuit (City of New Haven); Iran escalation driving oil above $106/bbl may pressure medical cost ratios via energy pass-through. (Source: web_research/UNH.json; swing_catalyst_news signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260504_194523.)

## Upcoming events

| Event | Date | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 10–28, 2026 | Next binary — consensus Q2 EPS ~$4.84; guidance cadence is market focus |
| RICO insulin pricing lawsuit | Unscheduled | City of New Haven suit vs UNH, Cigna, CVS Health — no timeline or liability estimate |
| Iran-Strait of Hormuz escalation | Active, May 4 | Oil $106+ WTI — indirect cost-of-care headwind; risk-off macro |
| US midterm elections 2026 | Ongoing | Healthcare policy campaign topic; managed-care regulatory exposure |

## Recent news synthesis

**Goldman Sachs Conviction Buy, $435 PT (May 1, 2026).** Goldman added UNH to its US Conviction Buy list citing improving Medicare Advantage underwriting cycle. Lifts analyst avg PT to $388.57 (from $377.83 on May 1). Overall consensus: 18 Buy / 4 Hold / 1 Sell across 23 analysts; high PT $444, low PT $270. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**Prior authorization elimination — structural positive.** UnitedHealthcare eliminated most prior authorizations for medical procedures — one of the most significant policy shifts in company history. Reduces administrative friction and supports member retention. Long-term structural positive; not a near-term price catalyst. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**Q1 2026 earnings beat (April 21, 2026) — fully priced.** Adj. EPS $7.23 vs $6.61 consensus (+10.2%); revenue $111.72B; MCR improved to 84%; FY2026 guidance raised to >$18.25 adj. EPS; $2B+ buyback announced. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**RICO lawsuit — unpriced legal overhang.** New Haven filed RICO allegations against UNH, Cigna, and CVS Health for an alleged insulin pricing scheme. No quantified liability. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260504_194523.)

**Minor institutional trimming.** Horizon Investments sold 27,059 shares on May 2 — not indicative of broad distribution. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260504_194523.)

## Insider activity

No insider activity recorded. Sentiment agent: 0 buys, 0 sells. Prior bullish signal (April 11, pre-earnings) fully absorbed. (Source: sentiment_analyst_agent, signals_combined.json, run 20260504_194523.)
